text: それと…　どうも　この　ジムには　じめん　タイプ　ポケモンの　つかいてが　あつまってる　らしい

structure.jp: じめん　タイプ　ポケモンの　つかいてが
あつまってる　らしい

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.span: あつまってる　らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end says 'it seems' or 'I hear', when the speaker is going on what he has picked up. どうも earlier in the sentence strengthens this unsure feeling. あつまってる　らしい = 'apparently they have gathered'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows the state left after something happened; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. あつまってる = 'have gathered and are there'.
